seeds.random_search: default_rng(42), one stream across eps/methods as in evasion.py

harness_check.method: Wednesday 1B flow re-run through attack_curve(); every cell compared with results/task1b_evasion_wednesday.json (stored rate must equal count/n to 1e-12)

thursday_evasion.method: 1B on the Thursday model/data: random search (200 tries), FD-FGSM, PGD-40 exactly as detector/evasion.py (imported); eps in the Thursday model's own scaler units; same 52-feature mutable mask; detection = still scored >= 0.5; black-box attacks in-process. Variant A uses evaluation_flows(Thursday split, Thursday model, n=300, seed=42) (draw 300 attack test flows, keep P>0.9: the 1B/1C convention). Variant B filters all attack test flows to P>0.9 first and draws 300 from that pool with default_rng(42) (all of them if fewer than 300)

benign_to_attack.method: 1B reversed on Wednesday benign flows: pool = benign test flows with P(attack)<0.1 under the Lab 1 model; 300 drawn with default_rng(42).choice (no replacement); the unchanged evasion.py attacks are driven through a score-flipped view (maximise P(attack)); eps in the Lab 1 scaler units; same 52-feature mutable mask; false alarm = P(attack) >= 0.5 after the attack

recommended_config.method: full_1r_frozen: detector.defend.adversarial_train(split, Lab1 model, eps_std=0.25, rounds=1, all rows, mutable mask with the 10 constant-in-train features frozen) -- identical calls to detector/ablate_1c_rounds.py; curve by detector.ablate_1c.detection_curve with the frozen mask
recommended_config.stored_reference: results/task1c_ablation_rounds.json config full_1r_frozen (the one-round frozen config is stored there; task1c_ablation.json holds only the two-round frozen config)

membership.method: same procedure as detector/membership_after.py: positions from membership.sample_positions(default_rng(42)); thresholds fitted on the disjoint calibration pool; target arm scored over HTTP from a local API serving the recommended model; Lab 1 model reproduces the original 1A numbers first

smoothing.method: randomized smoothing of the recommended model: sigma/n/alpha read from results/task1c_defense.json smoothing block; sigma standardized and converted with the model's own scale_; certify() on the same 200 test rows (default_rng(42).choice); detection under smoothing by the detector/smoothing_eval.py procedure (majority vote, Clopper-Pearson abstain rule, same SeedSequence seeds, sources defended_base/original_lab1/eot_pgd)

certify_200_test_rows.sigma_units: standardized; converted per feature via scale_ before sampling

detection_frozen_mask.attacker_mask: 52 mutable features minus the 10 constant ones (the recommended config's threat model; same mask the ablation evaluates it with)

detection_unfrozen_mask.attacker_mask: all 52 mutable features including the 5 mutable constant ones (no range check on the always-zero features)

certify_block.sigma_units: standardized; converted per feature via scale_ before sampling
